members.name: BZ2Decompressor
members.doc: Create a decompressor object for decompressing data incrementally. For one-shot decompression, use the decompress() function instead.

members.name: BZ2File
members.doc: A file object providing transparent bzip2 (de)compression. A BZ2File can act as a wrapper for an existing file object, or refer directly to a named file on disk

members.name: compress
members.doc: Compress a block of data. compresslevel, if given, must be a number between 1 and 9. For incremental compression, use a BZ2Compressor object instead.

members.name: decompress
members.doc: Decompress a block of data. For incremental decompression, use a BZ2Decompressor object instead.

members.name: open
members.doc: Open a bzip2-compressed file in binary or text mode. The filename argument can be an actual filename (a str, bytes, or PathLike object), or an existing file obj
